name: eo-style
note: Source of truth. web/tokens.css, matplotlib/*.mplstyle and matplotlib/eo_style.py copy these values by hand; change them together.

use.title: Roboto Condensed 500/700, uppercase, tracked
use.body: Roboto 400/500 for prose, captions, axis titles
use.mono: Roboto Mono for numbers, readouts, tick labels, tables, small uppercase labels, buttons

dark.use_for: control panels, live dashboards, anything on a screen

light.use_for: PDF reports, printed bench notes, slides on a projector

chart.highlight: series[1] (red) marks the one bar or line the reader should look at; everything else stays series[0]
chart.axis_titles: required on every axis of every chart: quantity, then unit after a comma ('Phase current, A')

motion.spinner: ax-spin: terracotta arc + orbiting dot; on anything running or loading

main_feature_fx.sparks: start, run, go, enable motor, power

brand.name: Excessive Overkill
brand.note: Logos are monochrome. The accent color below is a placeholder until brand colors are chosen.
